messages:
sophie (Marketing): Hey team — finalizing the launch post + webinar schedule. Target publish: Monday 09:00 PT, webinar Wed 10:00 PT. I need engineering to sign off on the changelog and confirm docs links by EOD tomorrow. Can we hit that?
eli (Engineering): OK, will look. Quick Q: which changelog slice are we shipping? full diff or highlights?
sophie (Marketing): Highlights + expanded notes for infra/compat. We'll link to the full diff in docs. Example link format: https://redwood.docs/changes/rel-2026-04 
maria (Docs): Draft is up: https://redwood.docs/drafts/release-2026-04 - includes guided migration and API examples. I'll finalize once eng confirms the api list.
eli (Engineering): Scanning now. Two small API name tweaks and one note about default batching behavior. I'll post inline comments in the draft before EOD.
raj (Product): We should call out the new batching config in the launch post — it's a good angle for cost savings. Timed with the webinar demo.
tim (Growth): Agreed. Also want a 30s explainer gif for the webinar landing page. Maria, can we extract a short snippet from the docs for that?
maria (Docs): Yep. I'll create a doc section intended for the GIF script and a short markdown snippet you can embed.
eli (Engineering): FYI deploy-bot scheduled a canary for Monday 07:00 PT. If the canary is green, we go live at 09:00 PT. If not, rollback and delay.
deploy-bot: Canary job created: canary/release-2026-04 — window Mon 07:00-08:30 PT. Notifying eng-oncall.
sophie (Marketing): Great — Eli, if you post the inline comments, Maria will update docs and I'll swap in links in the press post. Tim, do you need the final link by Monday 06:00 PT to update the landing page?
tim (Growth): Yes please — Monday 06:00 PT latest. If docs land earlier, I can stage the page and point to preview link.
eli (Engineering): Posted comments. Main blocking item: confirm KV cache behavior in edge cases — I wrote a short note. Once that's cleared I'll ack the changelog.
maria (Docs): Addressed Eli's note and updated the migration section. Preview: https://redwood.docs/preview/release-2026-04 — contains changelog anchor at #changelog and a short migration checklist.
raj (Product): I'll review the messaging angle and add a one-paragraph elevator blurb for the post (focusing on cost + reliability).
sophie (Marketing): Perfect. Quick checklist: 1) Eng sign-off on changelog (EOD tomorrow) 2) Docs final link dropped (Monday 05:30 PT) 3) Canary green (Mon 07:00) 4) Publish post (Mon 09:00) 5) Webinar registration live (Mon 09:30) — does everyone agree?
eli (Engineering): Agree on the checklist. We'll triage comments today.
maria (Docs): Agree. I'll ping when the final link is up.
tim (Growth): ✅ I'll prepare the landing assets and drip emails — need final link by 06:00 PT.
sophie (Marketing): Thank you! I'll assemble the launch post and the benchmark narrative draft referencing the cost-savings from batching — will share for quick review tonight.
raj (Product): One more ask: capture a small telemetry snapshot for the benchmark slide deck — average p95 latency and cost per 1k tokens. Eli, can you export that after canary runs?
eli (Engineering): Yes — will export p50/p95 and unit cost numbers post-canary and drop into the shared folder.
sophie (Marketing): Awesome. If anything slips, flag here and we'll adjust webinar timing. Otherwise, I'll follow up with a short checklist reminder tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
